collection: Dundee permanent tooth anatomy via TeethAtlas

limits: No independent right-side source meshes: right positions are derived mirrors.
Permanent teeth only; deciduous teeth not part of this 32-position catalogue.
Author collection includes an additional first-molar variant without Carabelli; no openly linked TeethAtlas GLB for that variant was found, and it is not required for 32-position coverage.

source_integrity.processing: Publicly redistributed GLB files generated by glTF-Transform v4.2.1 and compressed with Draco.

scale.note: Source node transforms vary; do not interpret object coordinate units or website display scale as physical millimetres. Website uniformly fits each whole tooth to max bounding-box dimension 3.5 for display. Preserve original files; choose and explicitly record a catalogue default scale separately, with per-case calibration still required.

orientation.gltf_to_blender_world_xyz: Blender X = glTF X; Blender Y = -glTF Z; Blender Z = glTF Y. Apply full hierarchy matrices before this frame mapping; verify import.
orientation.website_mirror: MODEL_MAP marks right-side positions mirror:true and selectTooth executes wrapper.scale.x *= -1 after fitting/centering.
orientation.library_mirror_note: After canonical alignment, mirror local Y and reverse triangle winding. Mesial remains +X; buccal side flips. Right-side objects have positive identity scale.
orientation.pin_frame: Pins are centered model/glTF world coordinates before wrapper display scale. THREE fitModelToView shifts the imported model by its full-world bounding-box center and uniformly scales wrapper only.

attribution_requirements: Retain author, original model link and CC BY 4.0 link; identify derivative changes including root removal, seam welding, orientation, scaling, mirroring, and any added cervical geometry. Do not imply author endorsement.
clinical_scope: Educational anatomical source models; preparation margin, insertion direction, cement spacer, manufacturing allowances and material wall thickness remain patient/profile-specific.
